rationale: The agent verified the user by matching full name and old ZIP code to a single account before attempting any profile changes. It correctly requested the full new address to update the default address and did not perform any write without explicit confirmation. When the user declined to share the address, the agent appropriately did not proceed. For product inquiries, the agent used tools to list product types and fetch product details, correctly identified the cheapest available T-shirt variant and accurately reported Bluetooth speaker and jigsaw puzzle options and prices. The agent also correctly stated that physical items require a shipping address and did not fabricate digital offerings. No unauthorized actions were taken, no unsupported claims were made, and no writes occurred without confirmation. While the address update and orders were not completed due to the user withholding necessary shipping details, the agent’s handling remained fully compliant with policy.
